pages:
The Monday Night War is raging.
WCW is losing, and losing ugly.

Tonight, two black trucks roll
into the RAW IS WAR parking lot.

Spray painted on the side:
nWo. The invasion has begun.

steps.say:
Let me make something
perfectly clear to WCW!

This is MY company!
MY ring! MY World Wrestling
Federation!

Anybody wearing those three
letters has no chance...
in HELL!

Hey yo.
Say hello to the bad guy.

You know who we are.
You know why we're here, chico.

Vince wants a war? Fine.
Big Sexy brought the army.

And you're the message
we're sending the old man.

Then come get some.
This is WWF country.

monday_night.requirement:
No DQ: {player} vs {SCOTT HALL}.
Watch out for {KEVIN NASH}!

pages:
{player} pins {SCOTT HALL}!
The Outsiders run for the trucks.

In the back, Vince McMahon
is smiling. For now.

Jackknife! {KEVIN NASH} leaves
{player} laying in the ring.

Three letters spray painted
on the mat: nWo.

Vince sends {player} to invade
Nitro. But someone is waiting
backstage...

steps.say:
Well let me tell you
somethin', brother!

Vince has been workin' you to
the bone for peanuts, dude.

Hollywood can make you a
millionaire, brother.
Guaranteed contract!

Put on the black and white.
Join the New World Order!

then.say:
Then whatcha gonna do
when the nWo runs wild
on YOU, brother?!

else.say:
Smart move, dude.
Now prove you belong.

steps.say:
Either way, tonight you
face the Macho Man, brother!

Ohhh yeahhh! The cream
rises to the top, dig it!

{player}, the Macho Man is
gonna snap into ya! Yeahhh!

pages:
{player} pins the Macho Man...
then hugs {hogan}!

The WWF locker room is stunned.
{player} has jumped ship!

{player} lost. {hogan}
raises his hand anyway.

"Too sweet, brother."
{player} is nWo now.

{player} beats {RANDY SAVAGE}
in WCW's own building!

{hogan} watches from the stage.
He is NOT smiling, brother.

The Macho elbow off the top!
{player} is pinned on Nitro.

But {player} said no to Hogan.
Vince McMahon took notice.

steps.say:
You turned down Hogan's money.
Damn it, I respect that!

But this is a WAR, pal.
And wars have casualties.

Vince. Nobody asked you.
Shut your mouth.

I don't like you. Never have.
But those WCW punks came
into MY house.

{KEVIN NASH} is out in the
parking lot. Go stomp
a mudhole in him.

And that's the bottom line,
'cause Stone Cold said so!

No rules! No referee!
I want them OUT of my building!

no_chance.requirement:
Parking lot brawl: {player} vs
{KEVIN NASH}. {buddy} has your back.

pages:
{player} puts {KEVIN NASH}
through a windshield!

{buddy} pours a beer over
Big Sexy. Hell yeah!

The Outsiders leave {player}
bloodied on the concrete.

{SCOTT HALL} tosses a toothpick
at Vince's limo. Too sweet.

Halloween Havoc. WCW's turf.
Vince's worst nightmare is
about to walk through the curtain.

steps.say:
I'm the best there is.
The best there was.

And the best there
ever will be.

Vince screwed me in Montreal.
Tonight, I screw him back.

And you, {player}...
you're just the man
standing in my way.

Then lock it in, Hitman.
I'm not tapping out.

Bret screwed Bret!
And he'll do it again!

montreal.requirement:
Submission match: {player}
vs {BRET HART}. Do NOT tap.

pages:
{BRET HART} taps out!
The Hitman can't believe it.

Vince McMahon is laughing.
No chance in hell, Bret.

{player} taps to the
Sharpshooter.

{BRET HART} spits at Vince
on the ramp. Payback.

WrestleMania. One match decides
which company survives.

steps.say:
Here comes the money, Dad!
Guess who bought WCW?

Shane?! You son of a...
YOU are behind this?!

Every Nitro. Every nWo shirt.
Mine. And tonight, your
company is mine too.
Over my dead body!

Winner takes all, brother!
The title AND the company!

Whatcha gonna do when the
nWo and the largest arms in
the world run wild on you?!

Hogan, I'm gonna end
the New World Order.
Right here. Right now.

winner_takes_all.requirement:
Winner takes all: {player} vs
{hogan} for the World Title!

scene.say:
WCW is DEAD!
And I OWN the corpse!

Shane, you're grounded.
And Hogan... you're FIRED!

The war is over.
The WWF wins.

pages:
A clean sweep. {player} is
World Champion, and the
nWo is history.
THE END

{player} pins {hogan}!
The WWF survives!

Vince buys WCW from Shane
for one dollar. Business
is about to pick up.
THE END

Big boot. Leg drop. 1, 2, 3.
{hogan} holds the belt high.

Shane McMahon owns it all.
Vince walks out in silence.
THE END

steps.say:
Welcome to the winning team.
No more working for the man.

Too sweet, chico.
Now go hurt somebody.

{hogan} says tonight on RAW,
you take out the People's Champ.

FINALLY... The Rock has
heard {player} sold out
to Hulk Hogan!

It doesn't matter WHY
you sold out!

{player}, know your role
and SHUT your mouth!

The Rock will lay the smackdown
on your candy ass! If ya smell
what The Rock is cookin'!

nwo_debut.requirement:
Invade RAW: {player} vs
{THE ROCK}. The nWo has your back.

pages:
{player} pins {THE ROCK}!
The nWo spray paints the
People's Champ.

Vince McMahon is screaming
in the back.

People's Elbow!
{THE ROCK} pins {player}.

{hogan} is furious, brother.
And Vince is waiting.

steps.say:
You! You ungrateful,
two-bit son of a...!

I MADE you! And you sell out
to Hulk Hogan?!
You're... FIRED!

Can't fire me, Vince.
I work for the nWo now.

Then meet my
insurance policy.

You turned your back
on this house. That's
a big mistake.

Now I'm gonna open up a can
of whoop-ass on ya. WHAT?!

And that's the bottom line,
'cause Stone Cold said so!

fired.requirement:
Street fight: {player} vs
{buddy}. Vince wants you dead.

pages:
{player} beats {buddy}!
The WWF is on its knees.
One night left: WrestleMania.

scene.say:
Brother, if anybody wears
that belt, it's Hollywood.

So the kid loses at Mania.
One way or another.

pages:
Stunner! {buddy} drinks
two beers over {player}.

But the nWo still has one
last play: WrestleMania.

scene.say:
Brother, if anybody wears
that belt, it's Hollywood.

So the kid loses at Mania.
One way or another.

pages:
WrestleMania. The nWo has the
WWF by the throat.

{player} has no idea
what {hogan} has planned...

steps.say:
Here comes the money, Dad!
I bought WCW. All of it.

Shane?! My own son
is behind the nWo?!

And {player} is my champion.
Tonight you lose EVERYTHING.

You have betrayed the house
the Deadman built.

Tonight, you will...
REST... IN... PEACE.

scene.say:
The WWF is MINE!
And {player} is the face
of the New World Order!

Hogan's done. Vince is done.
This is MY era now.

pages:
{player} beat the Deadman AND
survived the double cross.

Vince McMahon is out.
The nWo is forever.
THE END

{player} wins the World Title
in spite of {hogan}!

The nWo splits in two.
The war is far from over.
THE END

Vince laughs from the ramp.
Trust no one, brother.
THE END
